title: Attempted abduction and face cutting of 15-year-old Talia
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Attempted abduction and face cutting of 15-year-old Talia, about c. 2023 at San Antonio de Pintuyacu, Amazon, Peru, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: San Antonio de Pintuyacu, Amazon, Peru

tellings.quote: 15-year-old girl named Talia. She was almost abducted. That's why they the police went out there.

plain: A man named Tim Alberino, who investigates strange creature reports, told podcast host Jesse Michels about events around 2023 in San Antonio de Pintuyacu, a village in the Peruvian Amazon. He says a 15-year-old girl named Talia was almost abducted and had her face cut, and that this is why the police went out to the village, a story he relays from a man named Doug. He tells it as evidence of real attacks by unknown beings on villagers there.
